description: Paid endpoint ($0.01): pre-trade preflight for one Hyperliquid perp in one call: a short factual summary string plus perp mark vs OKX spot and vs oracle (bps), funding hourly/8h/annualized with next_funding_time and its extreme-funding rank, open interest and OI change vs ~1h/~4h/~24h/~7d ago (null until our snapshots cover the window), news sentiment if covered, as_of per component, and neutral flags (funding_extreme, oi_spike, venue_divergence, stale_component) with their rules. Factual checks only, no buy/sell call. Unknown symbol or unavailable data returns an error and no charge. Returns the x402 payment requirements and URL. Free sample response: https://cryptofeed402.site/samples/outlook

symbol.description: Hyperliquid perp ticker, e.g. BTC, ETH, kPEPE; HIP-3 builder-dex perps as dex:TICKER, e.g. xyz:TSLA

name: get_outlook
title: Pre-trade preflight (paid, x402) — $0.01

x402.behavior: Tool returns x402 payment requirements + URL; caller pays over HTTP with own wallet. Charged only on HTTP 200.
